blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Farm Fresh survived another five-setter and kept its sister team ZUS Coffee winless, 25-21, 16-25, 21-25, 25-19, 15-10, in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Thursday at Philsports Arena. The Foxies figured in a fourth straight five-set game and continued to prove steady to tie Choco Mucho at joint third place with identical 3-2 records. Veterans Royse Tubino and Ces Molina and reigning Season MVP Trisha Tubu joined hands to help Farm Fresh pull away in the decider with a 9-3 start and reached match point after Ria Meneses’ block, 14-6.
